Task S003 / v0.9.34

Christian Verrecchia · 23 November2026 · internally tested development preview; independent physical/commercial qualification pending.

1. Objective, physical model, equations, SI units, boundaries, algorithm and limits

# Reference multiwinding mesh / air study — S003

Solve a linear rectangular 2D/3D model with Matrix enabled. In Inductance, select the driven electrical ID and the other windings to short. Enter increasing integer Mesh factors and Air factors, each starting at1, then Run mesh / air study. The default `1,2` / `1` varies mesh at fixed outer boundary. `1` / `1,2` varies exterior size at the same nominal physical mesh spacing. A crossed grid, such as `1,2,3` / `1,2`, tests both effects together. The source CLI is `python tools/study_ports.py source.json study.json --input-id primary --short secondary --mesh-factors 1,2,3 --air-factors 1,2`; use actual canonical IDs from the electrical matrix.

Every point freshly solves the original reference field and all physical unit excitations. Canonical same-current grouping defines electrical ports; equal display names remain independent. The preceding S002 reduction enforces all selected shorted-port incremental linkages to zero, with every unselected winding current zero/open. This is a linear lossless ideal-short measurement, not a resistive AC load, a nonlinear tangent or a unique magnetising/leakage T-network split. Native Netgen controls do not apply to this study. Original accepted fields and the source project remain intact.

For mesh factor h and air factor a, outer width/height (and 3D depth) multiply by a; nx/ny/(nz) multiply by h*a. Every physical region and 3D sheet window translates by half the added exterior size. Physical geometry, feature separations, material laws, turns, polarities, electrical IDs and section order are retained. Planar extrusion depth stays fixed. Detached builder cases are flagged as edited; the original recipe is not silently rebuilt. Integer factors avoid target-rounding coarsening during air-only comparisons. Interior subdivisions between physical geometry planes remain unchanged at fixed h, but exterior-air topology changes. Domain sensitivity therefore includes exterior discretization differences; it is not an isolated, certified boundary-error estimate.

Original formulations remain -div(nu grad Az)=Jz for planar P1 triangles and curl(nu curl A)=J for spatial edge elements; B=curl A, W=integral(B dot H)/2. nu[m/H], A[Wb/m], B[T], J[A/m²], W[J], L[H], lambda[Wb turn]. Az=0 planar and tangential-A=0 spatial exterior boundaries remain closed. 2D paired source Jz=±NI/area uses original stack depth; 3D sources remain ideal closed rectangular sheets. No finite solved copper, native nonlinear/AC, new mesh kernel or certified estimator is added.

Each point retains its exact generated project, project/actual-mesh SHA256, fitted cell count, full electrical matrix, selected cancellation currents/linkages and original-current solver diagnostics. Selected1A energy is matrix-derived; original-current stats must not be interpreted as the shorted field. Relative changes use abs(Lnew-Lold)/max(abs(Lnew),abs(Lold),1e-30) along one axis while holding the other factor fixed. First comparisons are null. Identical adjacent actual fitted meshes are flagged and excluded from mesh-change evidence; increasing a requested subdivision number does not guarantee a changed fitted mesh. No automatic pass/converged label is issued.

At most6cases, factors1..3,24000actual fitted cells/case and240000cell-excitations total are accepted; work accounts for the original-current field plus every physical-source matrix column. Every case is preflighted before replacing accepted job state. Unsupported B-H, polygon or declared/assigned AC-solid inputs are rejected. Desktop preflight is synchronous before job acceptance; cancellation is qualified after acceptance and between/during numerical cases. Browser preflight uses a terminable worker. Original cancellation propagates between/during numerical cases; an incomplete study is not published. Browser worker termination retains prior accepted field/export data. Lower base subdivisions or reduce factors if the resource preflight rejects a large original model.

Actual six-point fixture results are in sample_results/port_study/. In 2D, requested mesh factors1and2 at air1 produce the same286triangles; the study flags this instead of presenting zero-change as refinement evidence. Factor3 gives364triangles and Lshort127.910504µH, versus119.418337µH on the coarse mesh (6.639% normalized change). In 3D at air2,378/1008/2940 tetrahedra at air1 become1350/5280/16224; the last two air2 values are99.587301and133.840929µH, a25.593% normalized mesh change. At mesh3, enlarging air changes131.482603to133.840929µH (1.762% normalized change). These coarse cases are not converged or design-qualified; small algebraic residuals do not remove discretization, source-model or boundary errors.

Focused tests separately check every geometry translation/material/turn, interior grid invariance, actual 2D/3D full studies and independently prescribed short-current field energy, invalid preflight/accepted-state retention and real cancellation. Reproduce from the source root with `python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_port_study.py -v` and `python verification/run_s003_cases.py`. Source-CLI reproduction here is qualified on Linux with UTF-8; Windows source-CLI locale handling is not qualified by the frozen-API smoke. QA/report generators, DOM/Wasm/browser test dependencies and snapshots are development-only. Continue source/p/order/domain/local-field accuracy, actual finite winding/return/core coupling, matched adviser/FEM conventions and native nonlinear/AC/full CLLC. No independent Maxwell/hardware correlation or clean-Windows10/11 offline release qualification is claimed.

For each actual unit excitation K a_j=b_j, L_ij=b_i^T a_j. Canonical same-current grouping forms the electrical matrix. S002 imposes i_p=1A, i_open=0, lambda_short=0 and solves L_SS i_S=-L_Sp, giving Linput=Lpp-LpS LSS^-1 LSp. S003 changes only the declared generated mesh/domain inputs and compares actual newly solved matrices. W=integral(B dot H)/2 and W=i^T L i/2[J] remain the same original linear energy definitions. Shorted1A quantities are derived from the actual matrix, while stats_at_original_currents describes the original prescribed excitation, not a new shorted field plot.

Both fixtures retain the preceding independent source definitions. Mesh targets start at2per axis, physical sizes/materials unchanged. The crossed grid uses h=1,2,3 and a=1,2. Exact original and generated source projects, translations, physical/mesh hashes, matrices, cancellation currents/linkages and real solver statistics are in sample_results/port_study/2d.json and3d.json. An identical fitted mesh at planar h1/h2,a1 is explicitly excluded from refinement evidence. The large spatial mesh changes remain unresolved; no Richardson estimate, calibrated estimator, accuracy bound or convergence/pass label is invented.

0001  """Reference linear multiport mesh/air sensitivity; empirical changes, not error bounds."""

0018      p=validate(project);require_static_sources(p)  #: Preserve original static source compatibility and canonical same-current membership.
0019      if any(m.get('bh') for m in p['materials']) or any(r.get('polygon') for r in p['regions']):raise ValueError('Port studies currently require linear materials and rectangular reference geometry')  #: Keep nonlinear tangent and faceted-geometry convergence outside this declared scope.
0020      if not isinstance(options,dict) or set(options)!={'input_id','shorted_ids','mesh_factors','air_factors'}:raise ValueError('Declare input_id, shorted_ids, mesh_factors and air_factors')  #: Require complete explicit electrical and variation intent without guessed defaults.
0021      keys=list(dict.fromkeys(series_key(w) for w in p['windings']))  #: Match reference electrical matrix order without merging equal display labels.
0022      if options['input_id'] not in keys or not isinstance(options['shorted_ids'],list) or any(not isinstance(k,str) or k not in keys for k in options['shorted_ids']) or len(set(options['shorted_ids']))!=len(options['shorted_ids']) or options['input_id'] in options['shorted_ids']:raise ValueError('Choose a known input and distinct other shorted electrical IDs')  #: Reject ambiguous short selections before launching field solves.
0023      mesh=options['mesh_factors'];air=options['air_factors']  #: Keep numerical refinement and exterior-air expansion as distinct axes.
0024      for values in [mesh,air]:  #: Require exact integer scaling so nominal physical spacing is held during air changes.
0025          if not isinstance(values,list) or not values or len(values)>3 or any(type(v) is not int or not 1<=v<=3 for v in values) or values!=sorted(set(values)) or values[0]!=1:raise ValueError('Factors must be increasing unique integers 1..3 starting at1')  #: Reject silently rounded, duplicate, boolean and unordered scale requests.
0026      if not 2<=len(mesh)*len(air)<=6:raise ValueError('Request 2..6 explicit mesh/air cases')  #: Bound work while requiring an actual numerical sensitivity comparison.
0027      axes=list(zip('xyz',['width','height','depth']))[:2 if p['mode']=='2d' else 3];cases=[];work=0  #: Preserve planar stack depth and expand all three exterior dimensions only in 3D.
0028      for a in air:  #: Group mesh comparisons at a fixed physical outer boundary.
0029          for h in mesh:  #: Refine the same source/material geometry independently of the air axis.
0030              check_cancel(cancel);q=copy.deepcopy(p);shift=[0.,0.,0.]  #: Honour cancellation and isolate every generated project.

0032                  shift[i]=p['domain'][size]*(a-1)/2;q['domain'][size]=p['domain'][size]*a;q['domain']['n'+axis]=p['domain']['n'+axis]*h*a  #: Keep physical source sizes fixed and nominal spacing size/n independent of air factor.
0033                  for box in q['regions']+([w['window'] for w in q['windings']] if q['mode']=='3d' else []):  #: Shift every region and ideal-sheet support together, retaining original ordering and polarity.
0034                      for end in ['0','1']:box[axis+end]+=shift[i]  #: Preserve all physical feature dimensions and separations under rigid translation.
0035              if q.get('builder'):q['builder_edits_after_generation']=True  #: Mark detached expanded-domain FEM cases as edited instead of silently changing their retained builder recipe.
0036              q=validate(q);fitted=build_mesh(q,cancel=cancel);count=len(fitted['elements']);work+=count*(len(q['windings'])+1)  #: Check actual interface-fitted work for all physical unit excitations and the original operating-point solve.
0037              if count>24000 or work>240000:raise ValueError('Port study budget: at most24000 actual cells per case and240000 cell-excitations total; lower base subdivisions or factors')  #: Bound both desktop and browser studies before a new job is accepted.
0038              cases.append(dict(project=q,mesh_factor=h,air_factor=a,translation_m=shift,actual_elements=count,project_sha256=project_digest(q),mesh_sha256=project_digest({k:fitted[k] for k in ['nodes','elements','tags']})))  #: Retain exact generated inputs and physical translation for independent reproduction.
0039      return dict(project=p,source_sha256=project_digest(p),options=copy.deepcopy(options),cases=cases,cell_excitations=work)  #: Preserve the complete original source and all explicit bounded study cases.

0033          self.token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
0034          self.lock = threading.RLock()
0035          self.job = None
0036          self.result = None
0037          self.field_result = None
0038          self.cancel = threading.Event()
0039          self.result_job = None

0041      def start(self, request):
0042          action = request.get('action','solve')  #: Identify separate component synthesis before requiring an unrelated FEM project.
0043          project = None if action=='design_transformer' else validate(request['project'])  #: Preserve all existing project validation while keeping requirements-driven design independent.
0044          if action not in ['solve','mesh','convergence','sweep','adaptive','ac','ac_sweep','ngsolve','openmagnetics','geometry_cad','design_transformer','port_study']:  #: Accept explicit isolated transformer design while preserving existing field and CAD actions.
0045              raise ValueError('Unknown analysis action')
0046          if action=='port_study':  #: Preflight all physical mesh/air cases without replacing the accepted workspace state.
0047              from engine.port_study import plan_study  #: Keep compiled native libraries outside reference-study validation.
0048              plan_study(project,request.get('options'))  #: Reject nonlinear/AC, unsupported geometry, invalid ports and excessive actual fitted work transactionally.
0049          if action=='design_transformer':  #: Validate catalogue design transactionally before replacing any accepted job or result.
0050              from engine.transformer_designer import validate_request as validate_design  #: Keep compiled libraries out of HTTP preflight.
0051              validate_design(request.get('design_request'))  #: Reject invalid targets, waveforms and constraints without changing the accepted workspace state.
0052              if not backend_status()['design_transformer']:raise ValueError('Transformer designer requires optional PyOpenMagnetics==1.7.35')  #: Make a missing native dependency an actionable preflight failure.
0053          if action in ['solve', 'adaptive', 'convergence', 'sweep', 'ngsolve']:  #: Mesh-only and dedicated AC/core-screening actions retain their distinct purposes.
0054              require_static_sources(project)  #: Return an actionable client error without replacing the previous job or field result.
0055          if action == 'geometry_cad':  #: Reject unsupported geometry before replacing an accepted job or result.
0056              from engine.geometry_cad import geometry_plan  #: Use lightweight preflight without loading a native CAD kernel into the server.
0057              if type(request.get('include_turn_solids',False)) is not bool: raise ValueError('include_turn_solids must be boolean')  #: Refuse ambiguous options before replacing a previous accepted job.
0058              if type(request.get('include_bobbin_sleeves',False)) is not bool or request.get('include_bobbin_sleeves',False) and not request.get('include_turn_solids',False): raise ValueError('Boolean include_bobbin_sleeves requires closed turns')  #: Keep inferred sleeve completion explicit and transaction-safe before native work.
0059              if request.get('include_turn_solids',False):  #: Bind optional turn geometry to the actual complete builder recipe before starting native work.
0060                  from engine.turn_cad import turn_plan  #: Run lightweight packing/source-consistency checks without importing CAD.
0061                  turn_plan(project)  #: Reject stale raw field edits, unsupported dimensions and overfilled blocks transactionally.
0062              if 'bobbin_parts' in request:  #: Validate all declared explicit geometry before replacing an accepted job or field.
0063                  if not request.get('include_turn_solids',False) or request.get('include_bobbin_sleeves',False):raise ValueError('Explicit bobbin parts require closed turns and exclude inferred sleeves')  #: Reject conflicting geometry modes transactionally.
0064                  from engine.bobbin_cad import bobbin_plan  #: Keep native CAD out of the preflight server.
0065                  bobbin_plan(project,request['bobbin_parts'])  #: Require exact source/anchor association and explicit typed SI dimensions.
0066              if 'turn_ports' in request:  #: Validate explicit cut dimensions/source binding before replacing accepted jobs or fields.
0067                  if not request.get('include_turn_solids',False):raise ValueError('Turn ports require individual turns')  #: Do not silently ignore selected cuts in ordinary box/prism export.
0068                  from engine.turn_ports import port_plan  #: Keep native CAD imports out of transactional HTTP preflight.
0069                  port_plan(project,request['turn_ports'])  #: Reject stale, null, duplicate or geometrically invalid terminal packets.
0070              if 'turn_links' in request:  #: Validate exact connection incidence/path data before replacing an accepted job or field.
0071                  if not request.get('include_turn_solids',False) or not isinstance(request.get('turn_ports'),dict) or request.get('include_bobbin_sleeves',False) or 'bobbin_parts' in request:raise ValueError('Links require individual turns and slit packet; bobbin/sleeves are outside this pilot')  #: Keep explicitly unsupported combinations and ignored packets transaction-safe.
0072                  from engine.turn_links import link_plan  #: Run pure source/graph/path validation without loading native CAD into the server.
0073                  link_plan(project,request['turn_ports'],request['turn_links'])  #: Reject stale cuts,wrong electrical owners,branches,cycles and invalid SI routes before starting a new job.
0074              geometry_plan(project, request.get('include_envelopes', True))  #: Keep polygon, complexity and thickness failures actionable and transaction-safe.
0075          with self.lock:
0076              if self.job and self.job['status']=='running':
0077                  raise ValueError('An analysis is already running')
0078              job_id = secrets.token_hex(8)
0079              self.cancel.clear()
0080              self.job = {'id':job_id,'status':'running','action':action,'log':[], 'started':time.time()}
0081          def log(message):
0082              with self.lock:
0083                  self.job['log'].append(str(message))
0084                  self.job['log'] = self.job['log'][-250:]
0085          def worker():
0086              try:
0087                  if action in ['ngsolve', 'openmagnetics', 'geometry_cad', 'design_transformer']:  #: Route transformer design, native FEM and CAD through the existing cancellable isolated process boundary.
0088                      result = run_backend(action, request, log, self.cancel.is_set)  #: Preserve real worker errors and avoid loading two CAD kernels into the GUI server.
0089                  elif action=='mesh':  #: Preserve the original mesh-only branch after the new isolated backend dispatch.
0090                      result = {'project':project,'mesh':mesh_public(build_mesh(project,log,self.cancel.is_set)),'kind':'mesh'}
0091                  elif action=='port_study':  #: Run the explicitly selected reference multiport study as an ordinary cancellable job.
0092                      from engine.port_study import port_study  #: Reuse the shared actual matrix/mesh/domain implementation.
0093                      result=port_study(project,request.get('options'),log,self.cancel.is_set)  #: Retain prior accepted fields when this separate study completes or is cancelled.
0094                  elif action=='convergence':
0095                      result = convergence(project,log,self.cancel.is_set)
0096                  elif action=='sweep':
0097                      result = current_sweep(project,request.get('winding_id'),request.get('values'),log,self.cancel.is_set)
0098                  elif action=='ac':  #: Route a single accepted AC job to the dedicated frequency-domain branch.
0099                      result = solve_ac(project,request.get('options'),log,self.cancel.is_set)  #: Pass the model, run settings, progress callback and cancellation flag into the real complex-field solver.
0100                  elif action=='ac_sweep':  #: Route a bounded AC frequency study separately from static current and mesh studies.
0101                      result = frequency_sweep(project,request.get('frequencies'),request.get('options'),log,self.cancel.is_set)  #: Pass the complete frequency list and common controls to independently recomputed AC solves.
0102                  elif action=='adaptive':
0103                      result = adaptive_solve(project,request.get('options'),bool(request.get('matrix',True)),log,self.cancel.is_set)
0104                  else:
0105                      result = solve_project(project,bool(request.get('matrix',True)),log,self.cancel.is_set)
0106                  if self.cancel.is_set():
0107                      raise Cancelled('Analysis cancelled')
0108                  with self.lock:
0109                      self.result = result
0110                      if 'fields' in result:
0111                          self.field_result = result
0112                      self.result_job = job_id
0113                      self.job['status'] = 'done'
0114                      log('Completed')
0115              except Cancelled as e:
0116                  with self.lock:
0117                      self.job['status'] = 'cancelled'
0118                      self.job['error'] = str(e)
0119              except Exception as e:
0120                  traceback.print_exc()
0121                  with self.lock:
0122                      self.job['status'] = 'error'
0123                      self.job['error'] = str(e)
0124          threading.Thread(target=worker,daemon=True).start()
0125          return job_id

0287  def main():
0288      ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Magnetics Studio 0.9.34 — MAS local native fit and limited magnetic FEM')  #: Identify the component-adviser release without claiming new FEM physics coverage.
0289      ap.add_argument('--project',help='JSON project for a command-line solve')
0290      ap.add_argument('--output',default='results.html',help='CLI self-contained HTML report')
0291      ap.add_argument('--json',dest='json_output',help='Full result JSON file')
0292      ap.add_argument('--vtk',dest='vtk_output',help='VTK field export file')
0293      ap.add_argument('--csv',dest='csv_output',help='CSV field export file')
0294      ap.add_argument('--port',type=int,default=0,help='Local GUI port (0 selects an available port)')
0295      ap.add_argument('--no-open',action='store_true')
0296      ap.add_argument('--pure-python',action='store_true',help='Disable acceleration even if SciPy is installed')
0297      ap.add_argument('--no-matrix',action='store_true',help='Skip unit solves for inductance extraction')
0298      ap.add_argument('--adaptive', action='store_true', help='Adaptive linear 2D solve, retaining ordinary solve as the default')
0299      ap.add_argument('--adaptive-passes', type=int, default=4, help='Maximum adaptive passes, 1–8')
0300      ap.add_argument('--ac', action='store_true', help='Linear 2D RMS phasor AC/eddy-current solve')  #: Add an explicit CLI switch for the limited linear planar AC analysis.
0301      ap.add_argument('--frequency-hz', type=float, help='AC solve frequency in Hz; otherwise use saved settings')  #: Allow a CLI frequency override; absent overrides retain the saved AC settings.
0302      args = ap.parse_args()
0303      if args.ac and args.adaptive:  #: Prevent unsupported mixing of the static adaptive loop with an AC analysis.
0304          ap.error('--ac and --adaptive are separate analyses; AC adaptation is not implemented')  #: Explain that AC-specific adaptation is not implemented instead of ignoring a requested analysis mode.
0305      if args.pure_python:
0306          os.environ['MAGNETICS_PURE_PYTHON']='1'
0307      if args.project:
0308          p = json.loads(pathlib.Path(args.project).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
0309          r = None if args.ac else (adaptive_solve(p, {'max_passes': args.adaptive_passes}, not args.no_matrix, print) if args.adaptive else solve_project(p,not args.no_matrix,print))  #: Skip any unnecessary static solve for an AC request; retain the existing static/adaptive paths otherwise.
0310          if args.ac:  #: Enter the explicit AC CLI branch only when requested.
0311              controls = {'frequency_Hz': args.frequency_hz} if args.frequency_hz is not None else None  #: Construct a named frequency override only when the user supplied it.
0312              r = solve_ac(p,controls,print)  #: Run the actual AC equations and forward progress to the terminal before ordinary result export.
0313          write_report(r,args.output)
0314          for file,value in [(args.json_output,json.dumps(r,allow_nan=False)),(args.vtk_output,vtk(r)),(args.csv_output,field_csv(r))]:
0315              if file:
0316                  pathlib.Path(file).write_text(value,encoding='utf-8')
0317          print(json.dumps(r['stats'],indent=2))
0318          print('Report:',pathlib.Path(args.output).resolve())
0319          if not args.no_open:
0320              webbrowser.open(pathlib.Path(args.output).resolve().as_uri())
0321          return
0322      server = make_server(args.port)
0323      url = f'http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}/'
0324      print('Magnetics Studio 0.9.34\nOpen:',url,'\nLocal machine only. Press Ctrl+C to stop.',flush=True)  #: Report the actual source version without changing local launch/shutdown behaviour.
0325      if not args.no_open:
0326          webbrowser.open(url)
0327      try:
0328          server.serve_forever()
0329      except KeyboardInterrupt:
0330          server.studio_state.cancel.set()
0331      finally:
0332          server.server_close()

0336      main()

69async function poll(signature){let missed=0;while(S.busy){await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,450));let j;try{j=await api('/api/status');missed=0;}catch(e){if(++missed<4)continue;throw Error('Lost connection to the local Python engine. Check its terminal.');}if(j.id!==S.job)throw Error('The active analysis changed in another browser tab');S.logs=j.log||[];renderBottom();if(j.status==='running')continue;setBusy(false);if(j.status==='error')throw Error(j.error);if(j.status==='cancelled'){S.logs.push('Cancelled.');renderBottom();$('statusLine').textContent='Cancelled';return;}const envelope=await api('/api/result');if(envelope.job_id!==S.job)throw Error('Result belongs to another job');if(signature!==JSON.stringify(S.p)){toast('The model changed during analysis. Solve the current model again.');return;}const r=envelope.result;if(r.kind==='convergence'||r.kind==='sweep'||r.kind==='ac_sweep'||r.kind==='port_study'){S.study=r;S.bottom='studies';}else{S.mesh=r.mesh;V.meshKey=null;V.polys=null;if(r.fields){S.result=r;S.study=null;$('fieldSelect').value='B';if(S.p.mode==='3d')$('viewSelect').value='volume';S.logs.push('Backend: '+r.stats.solver.backend,'Free DOFs: '+r.stats.dofs,'Relative residual: '+fmt(r.stats.solver.residual),'Energy consistency: '+(r.stats.energy_consistency===null?'nonlinear — see energy formulation':fmt(r.stats.energy_consistency)),'Matrix reciprocity: '+fmt(r.stats.reciprocity));if(r.stats.solver.gauge_residual!==undefined)S.logs.push('Omitted gauge-equation residual: '+fmt(r.stats.solver.gauge_residual));}else{$('meshToggle').checked=true;if(S.p.mode==='3d')$('viewSelect').value='orbit';}}$('statusLine').textContent='Completed · '+(r.kind||'magnetostatic solve');render();return;}} // #: Accept completed jobs through the original guarded polling path; clear an older study when a new field result becomes current.Accept completed jobs through the original guarded polling path; clear an older study when a new field result becomes current. 0009  function historyButtons(){$('undoButton').disabled=!history.length;$('redoButton').disabled=!future.length;}
0010  function remember(){const now=JSON.stringify(S.p);if(lastSnapshot&&lastSnapshot!==now){history.push(lastSnapshot);if(history.length>40)history.shift();future.length=0;}lastSnapshot=now;historyButtons();}
0011  function toast(s){$('toast').textContent=s;$('toast').hidden=false;clearTimeout(toastTimer);toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>$('toast').hidden=true,5500);}
0012  async function api(path,body){const options=body===undefined?{}:{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Studio-Token':S.token},body:JSON.stringify(body)};const r=await fetch(path,options);const d=await r.json();if(!r.ok)throw Error(d.error||r.statusText);return d;}
0013  function download(data,name,type='application/json'){const a=document.createElement('a'),url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([data],{type}));a.href=url;a.download=name;document.body.append(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),5000);}
0014  function safeName(){return (S.p.name||'magnetic_study').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+/g,'_').slice(0,100);}
0015  function autosave(){try{localStorage.setItem('magnetics-studio-v06',JSON.stringify(S.p));$('dirty').textContent='Draft saved in this browser · use Save project for a file';}catch{$('dirty').textContent='Use Save project to retain your work';}}
0016  function changed(){if(S.p.builder)S.p.builder_edits_after_generation=true;remember();S.result=null;S.mesh=null;S.study=null;V.meshKey=null;V.polys=null;S.logs=['Model changed. Generate a new mesh or solve.'];if(S.busy)api('/api/cancel',{}).catch(()=>{});autosave();render();}
0017  function applyProject(p,restoring=false){if(!restoring&&lastSnapshot){history.push(lastSnapshot);future.length=0;}S.p=p;lastSnapshot=JSON.stringify(p);historyButtons();S.sel=null;S.result=null;S.mesh=null;S.study=null;S.logs=['Project loaded. Geometry is editable; no field solution yet.'];V.zoom=1;V.pan=[0,0];V.meshKey=null;V.polys=null;$('projectName').value=p.name;$('fieldSelect').value='geometry';$('viewSelect').value=p.mode==='3d'?'cad':'slice';if(typeof cadViewer!=='undefined'){cadViewer.hasFitted=false;cadViewer.showAll();cadViewer.preset('iso');}$('statusLine').textContent='Ready · no solved fields';autosave();render();}
0018  function uid(prefix){return prefix+'_'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,9);}
0019  function getSel(){if(!S.sel)return null;return S.p[S.sel.kind]?.find(x=>x.id===S.sel.id);}
0020  function select(kind,id){S.sel={kind,id};renderPanels();draw();if(innerWidth<1000)document.querySelector('.right').classList.add('open');}
0021  function input(label,value,key,options={}){const type=options.type||'number';let el;if(options.choices){el='<select data-edit="'+esc(key)+'">'+options.choices.map(([v,n])=>'<option value="'+esc(v)+'" '+(String(value)===String(v)?'selected':'')+'>'+esc(n)+'</option>').join('')+'</select>';}else if(type==='textarea'){el='<textarea data-edit="'+esc(key)+'" spellcheck="false">'+esc(value)+'</textarea>';}else{el='<input type="'+type+'" data-edit="'+esc(key)+'" value="'+esc(value)+'" '+(type==='number'?'step="any"':'')+'>';}return '<label class="form-field '+(options.wide?'wide':'')+'">'+esc(label)+el+'</label>';}
0022  function wireFields(container,fn){container.querySelectorAll('[data-edit]').forEach(el=>el.addEventListener('change',()=>{try{fn(el.dataset.edit,el.type==='number'?Number(el.value):el.value);changed();}catch(e){toast(e.message);renderPanels();}}));}
0023  function addRegion(bounds){const d=S.p.domain,r={id:uid('box'),name:'New '+(S.p.mode==='2d'?'rectangle':'cuboid'),material:S.p.materials.find(m=>m.id!=='air'&&m.id!=='copper')?.id||'air',x0:d.width*.4,x1:d.width*.6,y0:d.height*.4,y1:d.height*.6};if(S.p.mode==='3d')Object.assign(r,{z0:d.depth*.4,z1:d.depth*.6});Object.assign(r,bounds||{});S.p.regions.push(r);S.sel={kind:'regions',id:r.id};changed();}
0024  function addWinding(){const d=S.p.domain,w={id:uid('winding'),name:'Winding '+(S.p.windings.length+1),turns:20,current:1};if(S.p.mode==='3d')w.window={x0:d.width*.3,x1:d.width*.7,y0:d.height*.3,y1:d.height*.7,z0:d.depth*.35,z1:d.depth*.65};else{for(const sign of [1,-1])S.p.regions.push({id:uid('conductor'),name:w.name+(sign===1?' +':' −'),material:S.p.materials.some(m=>m.id==='copper')?'copper':'air',x0:d.width*(sign===1?.25:.65),x1:d.width*(sign===1?.35:.75),y0:d.height*.4,y1:d.height*.6,winding:w.id,polarity:sign});}S.p.windings.push(w);S.sel={kind:'windings',id:w.id};changed();}

Nonlinear B–H curves are available in 2D. 0057  function renderMetrics(){const r=S.result,s=r?.stats;$('metrics').innerHTML=s?'<div><small>PEAK FLUX DENSITY</small><strong>'+fmt(s.peak_B_T)+' <em>T</em></strong></div><div><small>MAGNETIC ENERGY</small><strong>'+fmt(s.energy_J)+' <em>J</em></strong></div><div><small>MESH ELEMENTS</small><strong>'+s.elements.toLocaleString()+' <em>'+(S.p.mode==='2d'?'tri':'tet')+'</em></strong></div><div><small>CONVERGED · '+fmt(s.seconds,3)+' s</small><strong class="status-text">Residual '+fmt(s.solver.residual,2)+'</strong></div>':'<div><small>PEAK FLUX DENSITY</small><strong>— <em>T</em></strong></div><div><small>MAGNETIC ENERGY</small><strong>— <em>J</em></strong></div><div><small>MESH ELEMENTS</small><strong>'+(S.mesh?S.mesh.elements.length.toLocaleString():'—')+'</strong></div><div><small>SOLVE STATUS</small><strong class="status-text">'+(S.busy?'Running…':S.mesh?'Mesh generated':'Ready to mesh')+'</strong></div>';$('meshSummary').textContent=S.mesh?S.mesh.nodes.length.toLocaleString()+' nodes · '+S.mesh.elements.length.toLocaleString()+' elements':'No mesh';$('exportButton').disabled=!S.result&&!S.study&&S.p.mode!=='3d';}

0012  <dialog id="jsonDialog"><div class="dialog-head"><h2>Project definition</h2><button data-close="jsonDialog">×</button></div><p>Coordinates in metres. Validate and apply to update the workspace.</p><textarea id="jsonText" spellcheck="false" aria-label="Project JSON"></textarea><div class="dialog-actions"><button data-close="jsonDialog">Cancel</button><button id="applyJson" class="primary">Validate & apply</button></div></dialog>
0013  <dialog id="guideDialog"><div class="dialog-head"><h2>Engineering workflow</h2><button data-close="guideDialog">×</button></div><div class="guide"><p class="eyebrow">MAGNETICS STUDIO 0.8 · INDEPENDENT IMPLEMENTATION</p><h3>Guided builder</h3><p>Click Builder and follow Core type → Dimensions → Material → Air gaps → Circuits → Windings → Interleaving → Nameplate/build. The same circuit and winding inputs drive 2D and 3D geometry.</p><h3>Circuits and independent windings</h3><p>A named circuit, such as Phase U, contains its own winding count and winding definitions. Primary and secondary have independent turns, current and phase. Only physical layers of one electrical winding carry the same series current. Reorder those layers per limb to define interleaving. Single, multilayer and interleaved arrangements are supported. Declared totals and odd final layers are checked.</p><p>Signed instantaneous current is the default excitation. Optional sinusoidal snapshot mode uses peak current × cos(snapshot angle + winding phase). It is a prescribed magnetostatic point, not a voltage-driven or AC circuit solve. Phase names do not impose phase angles.</p><h3>Material and image digitiser</h3><p>Select a material, enter linear μr, import numeric B–H data, or click Digitise from graph image in Material. Load a screenshot, enter graph limits/units/scales and calibrate A=(Xmin,Ymin), B=(Xmax,Ymin), C=(Xmin,Ymax). Trace one monotonic positive branch. Scroll zooms; Shift/right-drag pans. Move/delete points or edit their SI values. Invalid points block application; including (0,0) is an explicit assumption. Images stay in the local browser. Perspective photographs are not corrected.</p><p>Nonlinear reversible B–H is available in 2D. 3D remains linear; storing a curve in 3D does not activate nonlinear physics. Temperature/frequency labels select curve data explicitly; no automatic scaling or loss model is implied.</p><h3>2D and 3D windings</h3><p>2D supports full winding-block rectangles or separately meshed round/litz/foil/rectangular turn sections. A region carrying n turns has Jz = ±nI/A. Each winding has both + and − sections, preserving total ampere-turns. Round curves are faceted polygons. Litz is homogenized within each bundle, not resolved strand by strand. Stack depth scales linkage and energy; planar end effects are absent.</p><p>3D uses closed ideal rectangular current sheets at the packing-defined mean radius and axial extent. It computes 3D field end effects in a finite air domain. Winding display envelopes do not represent finite-copper eddy-current physics. Curved toroidal 3D cores and individual 3D wires are not implemented.</p><h3>Mesh, solve and inspect</h3><p>Preview and check fit, then use the model in the workspace, generate mesh and solve. Standard 3D budget is 44k tetrahedra; the explicitly selected extended budget allows 120k and may be slower. The builder shows a mesh estimate. Uncheck Matrix for field-only analysis. Failed convergence is rejected.</p><p>Use 3D field volume for magnitude colours, volume arrows, traced B paths, transparency and capped core surfaces. Rotating field slice remains a single plane. Streamlines are approximate postprocessing of elementwise fields. The solid model view provides part selection, hiding, cutaway and display OBJ export.</p><h3>Results and verification</h3><p>Linear inductance uses independent unit excitations. Native 3D section matrices are grouped by electrical winding, not by circuit container. Per-container winding-pair leakage assumes the selected other winding is shorted and all remaining winding currents are zero/open; the full coupled matrix is retained. Nonlinear points do not have a constant linear inductance matrix.</p><p>Check finer mesh and larger air boundaries. A tiny algebraic residual or energy discrepancy alone is not evidence of engineering accuracy. The closed outer boundary imposes zero normal flux and is not an infinite open boundary. Sharp-corner field peaks can remain mesh dependent.</p><h3>Save and reuse</h3><p>Save project JSON for the workspace, builder input JSON for the recipe, or a digitiser session including the source graph image. Changing raw generated geometry flags the recipe as stale; rebuilding does not infer manual edits. Previous v0.5 recipes migrate with their explicit geometry preserved. CSV, JSON, VTK, PNG and self-contained HTML reports remain available.</p><h3>Release boundaries</h3><p>Independent research software with limited validation. Linear 2D AC/eddy-current analysis is available with explicit solid-conductor current constraints and RMS phasors. No 3D/nonlinear AC, transient, core-loss, hysteresis, thermal, permanent-magnet, force/torque, arbitrary CAD or general 3D adaptive-meshing solver is added. Linear 2D local residual-driven refinement is available from Analysis; its indicator is not a certified error bound. The circuit hierarchy is a modelling definition, not a general electrical network solver.</p></div></dialog>

0001  """Build a Windows one-folder development preview with installed native dependencies."""

0014      if sys.platform!='win32':raise ValueError('Build this Windows package on a permitted Windows host')  #: Do not produce a platform-mislabeled application executable.
0015      notices=ROOT/'build/notices';notices.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);inventory=[]  #: Stage exact dependency notices separately from executable code.
0016      command=[sys.executable,'-m','PyInstaller','--noconfirm','--clean','--onedir','--console','--noupx','--name','MagneticsStudio','--distpath',str(args.output),'--workpath',str(ROOT/'build/pyinstaller'),'--specpath',str(ROOT/'build')]  #: Build the actual browser-launching Windows application with inspectable console errors.
0017      for folder in ['web','data','examples']:command.extend(['--add-data',str(ROOT/folder)+';'+folder])  #: Include original runtime assets, physical examples and builder/material catalogue data.
0018      for package in ['engine','tools']:command.extend(['--collect-submodules',package])  #: Retain all lazily imported original application and native worker modules.
0019      for package in ['numpy','scipy','cadquery','OCP','netgen','ngsolve','OpenMagneticsVirtualBuilder']:command.extend(['--collect-all',package])  #: Preserve required compiled libraries and package data used by original optional backends.
0020      command.extend(['--hidden-import','PyOpenMagnetics'])  #: Include the pinned extension module even though it is imported only by a native worker action.
0021      for distribution in metadata.distributions():  #: Inventory and preserve notices for the actual installed transitive environment, not guessed direct dependencies.
0022          name=distribution.metadata['Name'];record=dict(name=name,version=distribution.version,license=distribution.metadata.get('License-Expression') or distribution.metadata.get('License'),source=distribution.metadata.get('Home-page'),notices=[])  #: Retain actual upstream metadata and source attribution.
0023          command.extend(['--copy-metadata',name])  #: Keep version guards and original dist-info licence data available inside frozen workers.
0024          for member in distribution.files or []:  #: Inspect declared installed wheel members without importing native code.
0025              path=Path(distribution.locate_file(member));relative=str(member).replace('\\','/')  #: Resolve actual native/notice bytes from this Windows build environment.
0026              if path.is_file() and any(word in path.name.lower() for word in ['license','licence','copyright','notice']):  #: Preserve original legal notice contents rather than paraphrase them.
0027                  target=notices/name/relative.replace('../','parent/');target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);shutil.copyfile(path,target);record['notices'].append(relative)  #: Keep each upstream notice attributable to its owning distribution.
0028              if name.lower()=='pyopenmagnetics' and path.is_file() and path.suffix.lower()=='.dll':command.extend(['--add-binary',str(path)+';'+str(Path(relative).parent)])  #: Retain runtime-loaded Kirchhoff/native DLLs alongside the actual extension layout.
0029          inventory.append(record)  #: Preserve complete observed transitive metadata with explicit missing notice lists.
0030      (notices/'DEPENDENCIES.json').write_text(json.dumps(inventory,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')  #: Make actual runtime dependencies and notice coverage inspectable in the preview.

+import copy  #: Preserve original source snapshots while generating detached numerical cases.
+import unittest  #: Record physical geometry, actual field and transactional rejection contracts.
+from test_port_reduction import three_ports  #: Reuse explicit nondegenerate preceding 2D/3D source fixtures.
+from engine.port_study import plan_study,port_study  #: Exercise genuine shared preflight and matrix-study execution.

+from engine.mesh import build_mesh  #: Inspect actual fitted physical-coordinate grids.
+from engine.sparse import Cancelled  #: Require actual interruption without a partial success result.
+from studio import Workspace  #: Check original accepted job/field retention under failed preflight.

+

+    if mode=='3d':p['domain']['nz']=2  #: Retain an actual spatial vector problem.
+    keys=list(dict.fromkeys(series_key(w) for w in p['windings']))  #: Derive independent electrical IDs from the canonical grouping.
+    return p,dict(input_id=keys[0],shorted_ids=keys[1:],mesh_factors=[1,2],air_factors=[1,2])  #: Request an explicit complete two-axis simultaneous-short study.
+
+
+class PortStudyTests(unittest.TestCase):  #: Verify physics and source identity rather than simply repeat reduction formulas.
+    def test_translation_spacing_and_unchanged_model(self):  #: Expanding exterior air must preserve feature sizes and source/material order.
+        for mode in ['2d','3d']:  #: Enforce the same contract for planar and spatial field problems.
+            p,o=fixture(mode);before=copy.deepcopy(p);plan=plan_study(p,o);self.assertEqual(p,before);a,b=plan['cases'][0],plan['cases'][2];q=b['project']  #: Compare equal mesh factors at different exterior extents without editing the source.
+            self.assertEqual(q['materials'],p['materials']);self.assertEqual([w['turns'] for w in q['windings']],[w['turns'] for w in p['windings']])  #: Preserve magnetic laws and electrical turns exactly.
+            objects=p['regions']+([w['window'] for w in p['windings']] if mode=='3d' else []);moved=q['regions']+([w['window'] for w in q['windings']] if mode=='3d' else [])  #: Compare every original core/conductor and source support in original order.
+            for old,new in zip(objects,moved):  #: Check rigid translation rather than geometric scaling.
+                for i,axis in enumerate('xyz'[:2 if mode=='2d' else 3]):  #: Keep planar depth outside the expanded exterior coordinates.
+                    for end in ['0','1']:self.assertAlmostEqual(new[axis+end]-b['translation_m'][i],old[axis+end],places=14)  #: Require identical physical dimensions and separations in the original coordinate frame.
+            if mode=='2d':self.assertEqual(q['domain']['depth'],p['domain']['depth'])  #: Prevent accidental planar linkage/energy scaling through changed extrusion depth.
+            ga=build_mesh(a['project'])['grids'];gb=build_mesh(q)['grids']  #: Independently inspect actual interface-fitted meshes.
+            for i,axis in enumerate('xyz'[:len(ga)]):  #: Compare all subdivisions within the physical component bounds.
+                lo=min(v[axis+'0'] for v in objects);hi=max(v[axis+'1'] for v in objects);old=[v for v in ga[i] if lo-1e-12<=v<=hi+1e-12];new=[v-b['translation_m'][i] for v in gb[i] if lo-1e-12<=v-b['translation_m'][i]<=hi+1e-12]  #: Place both numerical grids in the same source-relative coordinate frame.
+                self.assertEqual(len(old),len(new));self.assertLess(max(abs(x-y) for x,y in zip(old,new)),1e-12)  #: Catch unintended interior coarsening during air-only comparisons.
+
+    def test_actual_two_axis_fields_and_short_energy(self):  #: Study entries must come from real original FEM matrices on the declared cases.
+        for mode in ['2d','3d']:  #: Exercise separate actual H1 and edge-element magnetic formulations.
+            p,o=fixture(mode);study=port_study(p,o);rows=study['rows'];self.assertEqual(len(rows),4)  #: Execute the full explicit mesh/air grid.
+            self.assertIsNone(rows[0]['mesh_change']);self.assertIsNone(rows[0]['air_change']);self.assertIsNotNone(rows[-1]['mesh_change']);self.assertIsNotNone(rows[-1]['air_change'])  #: Retain independent axes and undefined initial comparisons.
+            if mode=='2d':self.assertTrue(rows[1]['identical_previous_mesh']);self.assertIsNone(rows[1]['mesh_change'])  #: Fitted geometry may dominate a coarse grid; identical meshes must not count as zero-error refinement evidence.
+            for row in rows:self.assertGreater(row['measurement']['input_inductance_H'],0);self.assertEqual(row['actual_elements'],row['stats_at_original_currents']['elements'])  #: Require positive actual port energy and identical preflight/solved mesh sizes.
+            final=rows[-1];q=copy.deepcopy(final['project']);c=final['measurement']['source_matrix'];currents=final['measurement']['current_A_per_input_A']  #: Prepare an independent field solve on the translated/refined model.
+            for w in q['windings']:w['current']=currents[c['group_ids'].index(series_key(w))]  #: Prescribe the reduced short-current mode on every original physical section.
+            check=solve_project(q,False);self.assertAlmostEqual(2*check['stats']['energy_J']/final['measurement']['input_inductance_H'],1,places=6);self.assertGreater(check['stats']['peak_B_T'],0)  #: Compare actual nonzero magnetic field energy against the selected matrix prediction.

+        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):plan_study(nonlinear,o)  #: Reject unsupported nonlinear characterization explicitly.
+        huge=copy.deepcopy(p);huge['domain'].update(nx=90,ny=90)  #: Exceed the shared actual fitted-work ceiling.
+        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):plan_study(huge,o)  #: Reject excess work before any study field is solved.
+        stopped=[False]  #: Trigger real cancellation only after the first numerical case has run.
+        def log(message):  #: Detect the next actual matrix-study case through genuine progress callbacks.
+            if message.startswith('Reference port study: mesh×2'):stopped[0]=True  #: Cancel before completing the second field solve.
+        with self.assertRaises(Cancelled):port_study(p,o,log,lambda:stopped[0])  #: Interrupted work must return no completed study result.

0001  name: Magnetics Studio Windows preview

+"""S003 actual reference mesh/air sensitivity evidence; development QA only."""
+import json  #: Retain complete real generated projects, matrices and comparison results.
+from pathlib import Path  #: Resolve delivered source and new evidence without touching old solved JSON.
+import sys  #: Import the exact shipped study and physical test fixtures.
+ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1];sys.path[:0]=[str(ROOT),str(ROOT/'tests')]  #: Bind this QA-only generator to this delivered checkout.
+from test_port_study import fixture  #: Reuse explicit physical 2D/3D multiwinding cases and canonical electrical selections.
+from engine.port_study import port_study  #: Execute genuine original reference field/matrix solves for every sample.
+DATA=ROOT/'sample_results/port_study';DATA.mkdir(exist_ok=True);summary={}  #: Isolate all new physical evidence from historical reports/results.
+for mode in ['2d','3d']:  #: Keep planar and spatial applicability separate and explicit.
+    project,options=fixture(mode);options['mesh_factors']=[1,2,3];study=port_study(project,options);(DATA/(mode+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(study,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')  #: Save every actual matrix, generated input, current response and numerical diagnostic.
+    summary[mode]=[dict(mesh_factor=r['mesh_factor'],air_factor=r['air_factor'],elements=r['actual_elements'],open_uH=r['measurement']['input_open_H']*1e6,short_uH=r['measurement']['input_inductance_H']*1e6,mesh_change=r['mesh_change'],air_change=r['air_change']) for r in study['rows']]  #: Report actual selected observables and independent-axis differences, not an assumed convergence order.
+(DATA/'numerical_summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))  #: Preserve a concise actual numerical result table tied to complete source data.
